episodes.title: Do You Want to Become Stronger?
episodes.summary: Shimura endures daily torment from school tyrant Hamaken. But his luck changes when a scuffle with bootlicker Kanegon accidentally goes live — and viral.

episodes.title: Fan the Flames of Anger
episodes.summary: Mugged by delinquents, Shimura follows TOU-KEI's teachings to fight back. Later, despite landing a blow on Hamaken, Shimura lands in even deeper trouble.

episodes.title: I'm Not a Loser!
episodes.summary: Humiliated in front of his crush, Shimura disappears. As everyone searches desperately for him, Kanegon endures brutal violence from Hamaken.

episodes.title: Well Then, My Friend
episodes.summary: Viral Hit faces its first crisis and Shimura must take on multiple opponents. Later, ex-taekwondo champ Shinjo targets them and attacks Kanegon.

episodes.title: The Original Viral Hit
episodes.summary: The Shimura vs. Shinjo fight reaches a shocking conclusion. Viral Hit reaches 1M subscribers, and the head of BAD FELLOWS approaches with a proposition.

episodes.title: This is My Youth
episodes.summary: As the final battle nears, Shimura's group face mounting challenges. TOU-KEI's secret emerges and their last fight begins — for friends, family and love.
